question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/887ab53700105cc9182613a3954939cf2dbecfac4f49f753cc91b40af87d8d18.png]
solution:
The images in the figure are shifting its position by rotating in:

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b756acff10c3372b6f331b4190e230da9589eab1b23223e46352edcce29b93e.png] → rotate in anticlockwise direction

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/408a5cb80edacfd86b2a0f1508337a1cfce8ccd94f5f4fd054ce6772b164f1ef.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad394658b79ffd3a5a3818f9b1943d28bfc756a21d9e0572ef52fe8c599f9d5c.png] → rotate in clockwise direction

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec760aeca02ef4535f77ebc11340dfb9f9a1c38c0de8b0b5a577982f1cfc5095.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c3c72819c047fc8cb608e720063c53d0dc24e2bd03a8a930b603fbd7c7a1e2b.png] → rotate in anticlockwise direction

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b54ca8e3d95d09880d6ed2bada934c5610ac325f9efdb12c6bffb4aef60b550b.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47941b2805e03dd852271e68d7073c8b5e17ae120a55e8b2a67bc9b163b723ef.png] → rotate in clockwise direction

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6436c0543230c2b6fe6ef7476bf07fccf00553575bdd4a4d3d2559ee46024ae1.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcd63b7a70c1bd29ac2367f141c349f0efb1c2571c5dcd611b61d074643c7507.png] → rotate in anticlockwise direction

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cc7484646deb442b751f7be1aefbe513e1fbb6f3afdc01794ee7545d14af37a.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ce996a374cc7cf61428719f98b60e7e6d6c722157cae738514173ac9b421676.png] → rotate in anticlockwise direction

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ff71e496d2bf3e7325a871e3d394d7ae78ac229153bee0058ea1c4b2b83aa08.png] 

Hence, '**option 2**' is the correct answer.
